mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, request_id, operation_type, config_id, config_key, version_id, version_no, schema_hash, runtime_datasource_id, runtime_datasource_code, runtime_table_name, operator_id, command_payload, command_digest, current_stage, task_status, retry_count, next_retry_time, lock_owner, lock_time, error_type, completed_time, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_lowcode_publish_task WHERE ( (retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND ( task_status = 'PENDING' OR (task_status = 'RETRY' AND next_retry_time <= #{now}) )) OR (task_status = 'PROCESSING' AND (lock_time IS NULL OR lock_time <= #{staleBefore})) ) ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_lowcode_publish_task SET task_status = 'PROCESSING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_time = NULL, lock_owner = #{owner}, lock_time = #{now}, error_type = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND ( task_status = 'PENDING' OR (task_status = 'RETRY' AND next_retry_time <= #{now}) OR (task_status = 'PROCESSING' AND (lock_time IS NULL OR lock_time <= #{staleBefore})) )
